items.text: Wach Jehova Nyasaye mane obiro ne Mika ja-Moresheth e ndalo loch Jotham, Ahaz kod Hezekia Ruodhi mag Juda e fweny mane oneno kuom Samaria kod Jerusalem.
Chik iti yaye piny gi ji duto modakie iye,
mondo Jehova Nyasaye mar oganda lweny obed janeno kuomu,
mondo Ruoth Nyasaye otim kamano gie hekalu mare maler.
Neuru! Jehova Nyasaye biro kowuok e kar dakne;
olor piny kendo onyono kuonde ma otingʼore mag piny.
kendo holni nobarore kapogore koni gi koni,
kendo mana ka pi maburore koa ewi thur.
Magi duto timore nikech bayo yo mar Jakobo,
Bayo yo mar Jakobo to en angʼo?
Koso kama otingʼore mar Juda to kanye?
"Kuom mano analok Samaria obed pith mar yugi,
Abiro olo kite mag dalano nyaka e holo
kendo abiro weyo mise mage nono li.
Gige mopa molamo ibiro toyo matindo tindo;
kendo mich mag hekalu mochiwo ibiro wangʼ gi mach;
abiro ketho kido mage molos duto.
Nikech michgo nochoko koa e chudo mar ochot,
omiyo koro ibiro ti kodgi kaka chudo mar ochot."
Kuom mano, abiro ywak kendo dengo;
abiro wuotho duk kod tienda nono.
Masira osechopo nyaka e dhoranga joga,
kadhuru ka un duge kod wichkuot.
Joma odak Maroth chunygi chandore ka nigi rem mapek
nikech masira osebiro koa kuom Jehova Nyasaye mochopo
tweuru fareseu e gecheu mag lweny.
Un ema ne umiyo nyar Sayun odonjo e richo,
nikech timbe jo-Israel maricho noa kuomu.
ne jo-Meresheth Gath, ok nochak ochungʼ kendo.
abiro ketou e lwet wasiku mabiro loyou.
biro pondo e rogo man Adulam.
nikech nyithindo muketo e chunyu ibiro mau miter e twech kaka wasumbini;

items.text: Chenro mar dhano gi mar Nyasaye
Mano kaka nobed malit ne joma chano timo richo,
Gokinyi ka chiengʼ wuok to gichopo chenrogi
nikech gin gi teko mar timo kamano.
Gigombo puothe gi udi mag ji
kendo kata anywolagi bende gimayo girkeni magi.
kendo ginichuognu wer malit mar kuyo ni:
Kuom mano ok unubed gi ngʼato kata achiel e chokruok mar Jehova Nyasaye
Jonabi mag-gi wacho niya, "Kik ukor wach.
Yaye od Jakobo, inyalo wacho niya:
Ulonyo oko lewni ma nengogi tek
kuom joma kadho ka ok udewo,
mana ka joma odwogo oa e lweny.
Nikech kae ok en kar yweyo maru,
kendo okethore ma ok nyal kony.
Ka ja-miriambo ma jawuond obiro kawacho niya,
'Abiro koronu wach mondo ubed gi divai gi kongʼo mangʼeny,'
to ngʼat makamano ema bedo janabi ma jogi ohero!
"Abiro chokou un duto ma ok orem, yaye joka Jakobo;
abiro kelo jo-Israel modongʼ kaachiel ma ok orem.
Anakelgi kaachiel ka rombe manie abila,
Jal mayawo yore modinore nodhi nyimgi kotelonegi.

items.text: Okwed jotelo kod jonabi mag Israel
Donge onego ungʼe ngʼado bura kare.
Umon gi gik mabeyo to uhero gik maricho;
ka uyiecho ringʼo oko e chokegi.
ka ringʼo midwa tedo e agulu?"
Kinde biro ma giniywag ne Jehova Nyasaye
Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho:
"Ne jonabi mane omiyo joga obaro oweyo yo,
Kuom mano otieno biro choponu ma ok nune fweny,
mudho nojuku ma ok nungʼe weche mopondo.
nikech ok giniyud dwoko moa kuom Nyasaye."
apongʼ gi Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye,
kod adiera kod nyalo mar hulo ne joka Jakobo kethogi,
Winjuru wachni, un jotelo mag dhood Jakobo,
Jotende ngʼado bura ka omigi asoya.
Jodolo mag-gi bende puonjo weche mag chik komigi chudo,
kendo jonabi mage koro wach mana komigi chudo.
To pod giyiengore mana kuom Jehova Nyasaye kagiwacho niya,
got matin mogerie hekalu nobed ka bungu motwere moyugno.

items.text: got mogerie hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye nobed gi teko e kind gode duto molwore,
kendo ibiro tingʼe malo moyombo gode duto
kendo ogendini duto nobi ma pongʼe.
"Biuru wadhi e got mar Jehova Nyasaye,
kendo wach Jehova Nyasaye nowuog koa Jerusalem.
Obiro ngʼado bura e kind ogendini
kendo nokel kwe e kind pinje marateke man machiegni kod mago man mabor.
Ginithedh ligengligi olokre kwe mag pur
kendo tongegi ginithedhi olokre pende keyo.
Onge piny mano kedi gi nyawadgi gi ligangla
bende ok ginichak gipuonjre ne lweny kendo.
Ngʼato ka ngʼato nobed e bwo yiende owuon mar mzabibu
kendo e bwo yiende owuon mar ngʼowu,
kendo onge ngʼama nochak omigi luoro
Kata obedo ni ogendini mamoko duto
wuotho e nying Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa manyaka chiengʼ.
to joma odhi e twech nobed oganda motegno,
Jehova Nyasaye noritgi e got mar Sayun
Yaye, in kama oger motingʼore mar rito rombe,
Angʼo momiyo koro iywak matek kamano,
marem chami mana ka dhako mamuoch kayo?
Ywari gi rem, yaye Nyar Sayun,
nikech koro ochuni ni nyaka iwe dala maduongʼ
En ema ochokogi ka cham midino e dier ot.
nikech abiro sidhoni tunge mag chuma.
Abiro rwakoni ombongʼ tielo mag nyinyo
kendo ibiro toyo matindo tindo pinje mangʼeny."
Mwandu magiseyudo e yore mobam ubiro walone Jehova Nyasaye,
mwandugi nochiwne Ruoth Nyasaye mar piny duto.

items.text: Chokuru jokedo mau, yaye dala maduongʼ mar jokedo,
kata obedo ni itin e dier dhout Juda,
nyaka kinde ma dhako man-gi ich nonywolie nyathi,
ka en gi duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasache.
nikech duongʼne nochop e tunge piny,
kendo en owuon ema nobed kwe margi.
kendo ka ginyono kuondewa mochiel motegno,
to wabiro yiero jokwath abiriyo mondo oked kodgi;
Gibiro loyo piny jo-Asuria gi ligangla,
piny jo-Nimrod ibiro loyo gi ligangla mowuodhi.
mana ka thoo moa kuom Jehova Nyasaye
kata ka ngʼidho ma omoko e lum,
Joka Jakobo modongʼ nobed e dier ogendini,
mana ka sibuor e dier le mag bungu,
kata ka sibuor matin e dier rombe,
kendo joma kedo kodi duto notieki.
Anaketh mier madongo manie pinyu mochiel motegno
ma ok unuchak ugo gagi kendo.
Abiro muko sirni mag nyasachu ma Ashera mi agol kuomu
kendo abiro ketho miechu madongo chuth.
kod gero kuom ogendini ma osedagi luora."

items.text: Wach ma Jehova Nyasaye nigo kuom jo-Israel
"Chungʼ malo, ket kwayoni e nyim gode;
thuche mondo owinj wach ma in-go.
"Un gode, winjuru wach ma Jehova Nyasaye nigo kodu,
chikuru itu un mise mochwere mag piny.
Nikech Jehova Nyasaye nigi wach kod joge;
Asemiyou tingʼ mapek e yo mane? Dwokauru ane.
kendo agonyou thuolo e piny wasumbini.
kaka Balak ruodh jo-Moab nongʼado rieko,
kendo kaka Balaam wuod Beor nodwoko.
Parieuru wuoth mane uago Shitim nyaka Gilgal,
mondo mi ungʼe timbe makare mag Jehova Nyasaye."
En angʼo ma dabigo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye
kendo akulrago e nyim Nyasaye moloyo?
Dabi e nyime gi misengini miwangʼo pep
koso gi nyiroye ma jo-higa achiel?
Donge Jehova Nyasaye dibed mamor ka akelone imbe alufe gi alufe,
kata ka kelone moo mamol ka aora?
Dachiw nyathina makayo eka wena kethona,
koso nyodo mar ringra eka wena richona?
To angʼo ma Jehova Nyasaye dwaro ni itim?
Odwaro ni iti gadiera kendo iher kecho ji
kendo iwuoth mobolore e nyim Nyasachi.
Winjuru! Luong Jehova Nyasaye ne dala maduongʼ
"Yie kum momiyi kaachiel gi ngʼama ochiwe.
Yaye oganda ma timbegi mono, bende wiya pod diwil awila
gi mwandu-u muyudo e yor mecho,
Bende dagony ngʼat man-gi rapim mag mayo ji
To joge mamoko duto gin jo-miriambo
Unukan gik moko to ok ginikonyu,
ubiro biyo zeituni to ok unukonyru gi modhigi un uwegi,
kod timbe duto mag jood Ahab,
Ubiro tingʼo ajara mag ogendini duto."

items.text: e puoth mzabibu e ndalo oro.
Onge olemb mzabibu mochokore ma dacham,
ngʼope mokwongo chiek ma agombo bende onge.
Joma oluoro Nyasaye bende osetieki morumo e piny;
ja-ratiro onge kata mana achiel modongʼ.
Ji duto pondo karito mondo ochwer remo,
moro ka moro manyo nyawadgi mondo odwodi.
Lweteni duto ariyo olony e timo richo.
jogi maroteke chuno ji gi timo gigegi magidwaro,
Joma nenore ni longʼo kuomgi; chalo gi kuth oriangʼ.
Joma ikwano ni odimbore mogik eigi richo moloyo kuth chiedo.
Kik igen kuom ngʼama odak e bathi
Nikech wuowi koro ochayo wuon mare,
kendo nyako noked kod min mare;
chi wuowi bende noked gi damare,
Anto amanyo Jehova Nyasaye gi wangʼa ka an kod geno,
kata obedoni asepodho to abiro chungʼ kendo!
Kata obedo ni abet e mudho
to Jehova Nyasaye biro doko lerna.
Nikech aseketho e nyim Jehova Nyasaye
kata mana sani ibiro nyon-gi piny,
mana kaka chwodho inyono e yore manie dala.
Odiechiengʼ migeroe ohinga mare biro chopo,
koa Asuria kod mier madongo mag Misri,
koa bath nam koni nyaka bath nam komachielo,
kendo koa got koni nyaka got komachielo.
nikech timbe maricho mag ji modak e iye.
Kwa jogi gi ludh odunga mari,
Ogendini biro nenogi mi wigi kuodi
ka le malak gi bund-igi e buru.
Gibiro wuok ka gia e kuondegi mag pondo ka gitetni.
Gibiro lokore gidok ir Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachwa,
ka giluor kendo un bende gibiro luorou.
kendo idir kethruokwa duto e bwo nam.
kaka ne isingori kikwongʼori ne kwerewa,
